claims.claim_text: Indexed Serban Vallimarescu is high-confidence matched to the Harvard graduate and U.S. Army lieutenant who recalled wartime service with OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare exact name, printed first-lieutenant rank and source-explicit OSS recollection form a coherent identity bridge.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from an exceptionally distinctive exact name, matching commissioned rank and an institutional oral history explicitly placing him with OSS.
claims.temporal_assessment: The oral history and biographical header provide prewar education and wartime Army dates but not the exact OSS accession date.
claims.match_notes: The index note 'also AS' is preserved without interpretation; no employer is inferred from Harvard attendance or Army service.

claims.claim_text: Serban Vallimarescu attended Harvard and received a BA in 1942 before his documented wartime Army service.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence rare-name and explicit OSS oral-history match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded before or at the start of Army service; student status is not employment.
claims.match_notes: Harvard is classified as a student institution and excluded from employer analytics.

claims.claim_text: Serban Vallimarescu served in the U.S. Army as a lieutenant from 1942 to 1945.

claims.temporal_assessment: Wartime military pathway; the exact relation between Army assignment and OSS service is not established.
claims.match_notes: Military assignment is kept distinct from a civilian employer and from the still-unresolved immediate OSS predecessor.

claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish 1939 professional activity and later OSS service but do not explicitly narrate the transition.
